title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
During our first week at orientation, I didn’t take many photos, but I did still work at my part-time job of puppy yoga.


My first few weeks of the MDS program have been a whirlwind to say the least! Orientation was a wealth of information on how to best tackle the program, where to find resources available to us, and a wonderful way to meet the people in my cohort.
On top of the beginning of MDS, I began my first ever TA position. So far, I am loving it, and I don’t want to jinx it but the balance between MDS work and grading has been good! It is nice to have another task to focus on.
I have found the process of learning git and how to submit assignments to be challenging, but very interesting. At this point, I think DSCI 551 will be the most challenging course for myself in block one, but we have quiz week next week so time will tell!

title: About
text: I was drawn to data science after completing a handful of data and informatics courses during my undergrad. In particular, my INFO 419 (I believe) course was very inspiring. We learned all about information processing and ethics, and I found myself wanting to learn more and more about data practices. Outside of school, I am an avid reader and rugby player! Beyond that, I found myself lacking enough time to pursue my other hobbies such as drawing and painting. I do hope to pick these back up once I finish this degree:)

title: Delaney Woods
text:
My name is Delaney Woods, and I grew up in Victoria located on Vancouver Island. I studied in the BMS program at UBC prior to commencing the MDS program and I am hoping to learn a great deal about data structures and appropriate data practices to eventually work in the data ethics field! (Maybe in healthcare, maybe in sports science, who knows!:)
